title: Wheat-Paste Grotesk — Unfiltered Portfolio
description: A confrontational, full-bleed portfolio template for creatives who refuse to be polite — oversized compressed grotesque headlines bleed past the viewport edge while a single violent neon accent detonates against raw concrete grey. Zero apologies, zero rounded corners, maximum intent.

typography.heading: compressed grotesque, ultra-black weight, extremely high x-height, negative tracking, optically aggressive stroke contrast
typography.body: fixed-pitch monospace, regular weight, wide letter-spacing, used exclusively for metadata and captions

layoutNotes: Hard-left flush layout with zero left margin — the headline block originates at the raw canvas edge and is permitted to clip the right boundary at 200px+ scale. A loose 4-column grid governs secondary content, but one metadata element (project year, medium, or role) is deliberately dropped 10–15% below its natural baseline, breaking the grid as a structural statement. All containers and image frames use strict 90-degree corners with 1px hairline borders in either pure black or the neon accent; no shadows, no radius. The neon accent is applied aggressively to no more than one element per slide — a rule, a label, or a crop border — never decoratively.
promptCore: Design a slide with confrontational brutalist character — raw, full-bleed, and unapologetic, where an oversized compressed headline tears across the canvas edge rather than sitting politely within it. One violent neon accent detonates against concrete grey on a single structural element only, never used decoratively. All geometry is hard right-angles and hairline borders; no shadows, no softness, no rounding. Grid discipline exists to be broken — one metadata element drops deliberately out of alignment as a structural statement, not an accident.
goodFor: creative director or art director title cards
motion reel intro and chapter-break slides
avoidFor: multi-column body copy or long-form text
warm, approachable, or friendly brand identities
author: harness
